run_f_gold: run f_gold to multiply a number by 7 using bitwise left shift and subtraction
test_f_gold: test f_gold with integer inputs to verify it correctly computes n times 7
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses n left-shifted by 3 minus n to multiply by 7
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept additional numeric types beyond integers
review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness when multiplying negative numbers by 7
